correctness.rationale: Distinct subset binary weights yield exactly C(n,k) ambient fixed coordinate hyperplanes. For each k-subset I, replacing two of its indices constructs a tangent point e_J with |I intersect J|=k-2, so coordinate functional p_I annihilates the entire affine tangent span (which requires intersection >=k-1). All ambient fixed hyperplanes are thus in the invariant projective dual. C*-Euler localization on its projective, potentially singular, variety gives chi=C(n,k). Compact-support additivity gives complement chi=0. k=1,n-1 correctly excluded. This all-n proof does not rely on finite checks.

value.rationale: Determines a global topological invariant of generally highly singular projective duals uniformly in k,n, including Pfaffian degeneracy cases, via a non-obvious complete fixed-point inclusion. It yields a zero Euler characteristic for the complement. This is mathematically motivated by contrasting complicated singular geometry with ambient chi; it does not claim deeper Betti or Hodge data.

final_claim: For complex Plücker Gr(k,n), 2<=k<=n-2, the singular projective dual has ordinary topological Euler characteristic binomial(n,k), the same as the ambient dual projective space; the projective-space boundary cases have empty dual.
